metadata.title: L'ALIMENTATION ET LES RÉGIMES CHEZ L'HOMME SAIN OU MALADE

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, unbracketed hair-line serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was standard for academic and formal publishing in France during the early 20th century.
